title: Role router
shows: Pick a role: student, staff, or parent. Routes to the matching sign-in.
own: Platform auth. Chrome is student until a role is chosen.
who: Anyone opening the app URL without a remembered role.
why: One URL serves three doors — student, staff, parent — without three bookmarks.
how: Pick Student, Staff, or Parent. The app routes to the matching sign-in — one identity still threads the timeline.
when: First visit, shared device, or after logout.

title: Student sign-in
shows: Student sign-in (phone OTP default, email magic link optional). Lands on a student screen on this template — not staff.
own: Student holds the identity. Owner chooses OTP vs magic-link.
why: One identity for sessions, practice, doubts, and fees — no password in v1.
how: Phone OTP by default; email magic-link optional. The same identity is used for the whole record.
when: Every time they open the student app.

title: Staff sign-in
shows: Staff sign-in (OTP / magic-link + 2FA). Lands on a faculty screen on this template — not the student app.
own: Faculty or owner via staff membership.
why: Staff must not share the student app; membership decides the workspace.
how: Same OTP / magic-link as students. Membership decides which console they enter.
when: Opening the web teaching or owner console.

title: Workspace setup
shows: Create workspace: name, timezone, subdomain. Always-on core flags on.
why: The tenant spine must exist before branding, invites, or teaching.
how: Name, timezone, subdomain. Always-on core stays on (identity, timeline, quotas). Feature flags for extra modules come next.
when: Day 0 of a new tenant — before branding or invites.

title: Branding & domain
shows: Logo, colours, subdomain. Custom domain later.
why: Learners must recognise the workspace as theirs, not a generic TutorOS shell.
how: Logo, accent colour, subdomain. Custom domain is later.
when: Immediately after workspace setup, before the first invite.

title: Roster
shows: Student list, add, CSV import. Admin WhatsApp on new enrollment if opted in.
own: Owner or assistant with roster rights.
why: Who is enrolled is the source of seats, timelines, and billing — not a spreadsheet.
how: Add students one by one or CSV import. Optional admin WhatsApp on new enrollment — not a second student list.
when: Enrolment, then whenever someone joins or leaves.

title: Cohort builder
shows: Batches / groups / 1-on-1 pairings. Topic taxonomy is tenant-defined.
why: Teaching is grouped; 1-on-1 is a pairing. Topics are tenant taxonomy, not a baked syllabus.
how: Batches, groups, or 1-on-1 pairings. Topics are G3 — never exam-board tables in core.
when: After roster, before the first scheduled class.

title: Parent link
shows: Invite token to link a guardian to a student. After accept: activity, marksheet, results, receipts, teacher chat — own child only.
own: Owner issues the invite; parent accepts.
who: Guardian, invited by owner or teacher.
why: A guardian needs access without a second student account.
how: Open the invite token and confirm the student link. Then the parent hub: activity, marksheet, results, receipts, teacher chat — own child only.
when: Enrolment for minors, or any tenant that wants a parent portal (K-12, music, exam-prep).

title: Parent home
shows: Guardian hub for linked children only: activity, progress/marksheet, test results, fee receipts, teacher chat.
own: Parent (read). Owner enables the parent module.
why: The parent hub for their own child — not a second gradebook and not the class roster.
how: Open activity (timeline), progress/marksheet (reports), test results (practice-result), fees and receipts (payments), and a thread with the teacher (messages). Read-only except pay and chat.
when: After class, a result, a report, or an invoice — not during live teaching.

title: Schedule / calendar
shows: Calendar of sessions. Create/reschedule notifies teacher, parent, admin via D5.
why: Sessions must exist on a calendar before anyone can join.
how: Create or move sessions. Reschedule notifies teacher, parent, and admin via D5 — students only if the owner enabled student WhatsApp.
when: Weekly planning and same-day changes.

title: Session detail (pre-class)
shows: Pre-class detail: topic, cohort, Meet or Teams link, join URL.
why: Topic and video pointer must be set before the room opens. TutorOS does not host video.
how: Confirm topic, cohort, Meet or Teams link, and the platform join URL.
when: Before the session starts.

title: Join page / waiting room
shows: Waiting room. Students join through the platform; Meet URL is not the attendance source.
own: Student action; faculty owns the session.
why: Attendance is joining through the platform, not opening Meet in another tab.
how: Waiting room. Stay here until class starts.
when: Minutes before class.

title: Live session console
shows: Teacher console shell around the video session.
why: Notes, polls, and attendance must stay in TutorOS, not trapped in Meet chat.
how: Console around Meet/Teams. Teaching still happens in Google or Microsoft.
when: During the live class.

title: Live session view
shows: Student live view / waiting overlay.
why: Join, leave, and later replay must attach to one identity.
how: Live view / waiting overlay. Stay inside the product.
when: During the live class.

title: Session video & transcript
shows: Recording / Meet or Teams link. Transcript panel empty until STT or import.
own: Faculty. Student if the tenant shares replay.
who: Teacher (student if the tenant shares replay).
why: Replay lives at Google or Microsoft; we store the pointer, not the file.
how: Open the Meet/Teams recording. Transcript panel stays empty until STT or an import — do not fake captions.
when: After class, for replay or notes.

title: Session record & event transcript
shows: Attendance, notes, board photos, link. Fan-out to each attendee timeline.
own: Faculty must write. System fans out to timelines.
why: This is the ledger write after class. Channels do not replace it.
how: Write attendance, notes, board photos, and the link. That write fans out to each attendee timeline.
when: Immediately after class. Do not skip this screen.

title: Content library
shows: Lessons, files, links. Visibility per cohort.
why: Content between sessions needs a place that is not a WhatsApp file dump.
how: Lessons, files, and links with visibility per cohort. Folders follow the tenant taxonomy.
when: Between classes, or as drip content in a cohort course.

title: Lesson / module viewer
shows: Single lesson / module viewer.
why: Opening or finishing a module must be a timeline event, not a silent file view.
how: Open one module. Progress writes to the record.
when: When assigned, or self-paced between sessions.

title: Assignment issue
shows: Issue homework with due date.
why: Homework is a dated obligation on the record, not a chat reminder.
how: Issue homework with a due date. WhatsApp may remind parent/teacher — it does not replace the assignment.
when: After class, or as a standing weekly task.

title: Assignment submit & grade
shows: Submit, grade, return.
why: Returned work must land on the timeline so a parent can see it without a second app.
how: Submit, mark, return.
when: After the due date, or as work comes in.

title: Question bank
shows: Item bank tagged by tenant taxonomy, not a hardcoded syllabus.
why: Reusable items tagged by tenant topics — never a hardcoded syllabus in core.
how: Hand-pick or filter by tag into practice and tests.
when: Before building a practice set or mock.

title: Practice set builder
shows: Same-day or scheduled practice set from tags or hand-pick.
why: Exam-prep needs a same-day practice loop; other templates may leave this off.
how: Same-day or scheduled set from tags or hand-pick.
when: After a concept class, or as a weekly drill window.

title: Practice player
shows: Student practice player.
why: The learner does the work. No fake instant tutor in the player.
how: Answer on the phone. Honest timer and progress.
when: Same day as class, or inside the assigned window.

title: Practice result & tagged key
shows: Score plus tagged misses. A row cannot close on a percentage alone.
own: Student sees it. Faculty owns the next action.
who: Student first; teacher uses Analysis next.
why: A row cannot close on a percentage alone — tags drive what happens next.
how: Score plus tagged misses.
when: Immediately after the set.

title: Test / mock setup
shows: Timed paper setup.
why: A timed paper is a scheduled event, not a casual practice set.
how: Build the paper from the bank and set the window.
when: Mock week, or end of a module in a cohort course.

title: Test runner
shows: Student test runner with timer.
why: An attempt must write even if they leave early.
how: Timed runner during the window only.
when: During the scheduled window only.

title: Analysis → remediation board
shows: Most-missed items, tags, required action.
why: Misses become the next class — this is the exam-prep spine after practise.
how: Most-missed items, tags, required next action (re-teach, practice, backlog).
when: After a practice set or mock, before the next class.

title: Doubts queue (student)
shows: Photo or text doubt. Honest queue, not fake instant.
why: Doubts must live in-product so they are not lost in WhatsApp. Honest queue — no fake instant.
how: Photo or text into the queue.
when: Stuck after class, practice, or homework.

title: Doubts triage (teacher)
shows: Teacher triage. SLA timer. WhatsApp ping on new / SLA, not a second inbox.
why: Unanswered doubts need an SLA. WhatsApp is a ping, not a second inbox.
how: Triage the queue. Resolve here so the timeline has the answer.
when: Daily backlog, especially after practice.

title: Message threads
shows: In-platform threads so the record exists. WhatsApp may notify.
who: Teacher starts; student (and parent if linked) reply.
why: 1:1 coaching must exist as a record, not only as a WhatsApp chat.
how: In-platform threads. WhatsApp may notify teacher, parent, or admin.
when: Anything that is not a one-to-cohort announcement.

title: Announcements
shows: One-to-cohort broadcast. Parent WhatsApp if opted in.
why: One message to a cohort — schedule, dates, policy — not 1:1 coaching.
how: Broadcast. Parent WhatsApp if opted in. Students are not on WhatsApp unless the owner enabled it.
when: Schedule changes, exam dates, policy.

title: Student timeline / record log
shows: Append-only event stream for one student. The ledger.
own: Student is the subject. System writes. Faculty and parent read.
who: Student owns the stream; teacher and parent read.
why: This is the ledger. Channels deliver; they do not replace this screen.
how: Append-only event log. Automatic writes from session record, practice, payments, doubts.
when: After every session, assignment, payment, or doubt.

title: Notification preferences
shows: Role-aware channel + event checklist: teacher, parent, admin. Student WhatsApp off unless owner enabled.
own: Signed-in person. Owner gates student WhatsApp.
who: The person signed in (student here; staff/parent have the same idea).
why: Channels are optional; the ledger is not. Student WhatsApp stays off unless the owner enabled it.
how: Channel + event checklist for teacher, parent, admin (and student if gated on).
when: First login, and whenever they want quieter notifications.

title: Student dashboard
shows: Next session, open practice, doubts, this week.
why: Opening the app should show the next action, not a hunt through menus.
how: Next session, open practice, open doubts, this week. Few controls, clear next step.
when: Opening the app, not during a live class.

title: Teacher dashboard
shows: Cohort health: attendance, practice completion, doubt backlog.
why: Cohort health in one place — who is behind — instead of a second spreadsheet.
how: Attendance, practice completion, doubt backlog. Jump to the record.
when: Morning briefing before class.

title: Owner console
shows: Operating scorecard plus quota bars (80% / 100%). Feature kill switches.
why: Running the business (scorecard, quotas, kill switches) is not teaching a class.
how: Quota bars warn at 80% and can block paid sends at 100%. Caps throttle cost, not always-on core.
when: Operating the workspace, not during a live session.

title: Reports & exports
shows: Parent/term reports and CSV. Parent WhatsApp when a report is ready.
own: Faculty or owner produce. Parent receives a slice.
who: Teacher or owner; parent gets a slice.
why: A term view of the timeline — not a parallel gradebook.
how: Term reports and CSV. Parent WhatsApp when a report is ready.
when: Weekly check-in or term-end.

title: Mentor / backlog workflow
shows: Short slots on skipped work — not re-teaching.
why: Catch skipped work in a short slot — not re-teach the whole class.
how: Backlog items, often auto-created from missed practice.
when: After a tagged fail or two missed practices.

title: Student billing & plans
shows: Student fee plans and invoices (tenant collecting from learners).
own: Owner or assistant with billing rights.
why: The tenant collects from learners here. Separate from the platform subscription (F2).
how: Fee plans and invoices.
when: Enrolment and renewals.

title: Payments & invoices
shows: Pay an invoice. Admin/parent WhatsApp on captured or failed.
own: Payer (student or parent). Owner configures collection.
why: Paying an invoice must write to the timeline; WhatsApp only notifies.
how: Pay in-app. Admin and parent WhatsApp on captured or failed.
when: When an invoice is due.

title: Platform subscription & usage
shows: Tier, meters, caps at or below sold quota, channel matrix, 24h WhatsApp pause.
why: Platform cost (WhatsApp, storage, seats) must be visible and cap-able.
how: Plan and meters. Warn at 80%. Caps throttle usage; they do not remove identity, timeline, or this screen.
when: Monthly ops, and whenever a bar approaches the cap.

title: Payouts / revenue share
shows: Multi-teacher payout statements.
why: Institutes share revenue with teachers after collections. Starter 1-on-1 usually skips this.
how: Revenue-share runs after a billing cycle.
when: After collections, institute-scale only.

title: Audit log & data export
shows: Staff mutation log and data export.
why: Who changed what, plus export, for disputes and DPDP / GDPR.
how: Audit log and workspace export. Guardian consent for minors is captured at enrolment.
when: Staff change, a dispute, or a data request — not daily teaching.

title: What kind of tutoring?
shows: What kind of tutoring? Sets ~15 module toggles. Not a subject picker.
why: The tutoring shape must be chosen before modules turn on. Everything is a gallery, not the default live tenant.
how: Pick exam-prep, 1-on-1, K-12, skills, music, or explore Everything.
when: First setup step, before template and branding.

title: Template gallery
shows: Named templates: exam-prep, 1-on-1, K-12, skills, music, everything.
why: See which modules each template turns on before going live.
how: Stay on Everything only to explore; ship a focused template, then add modules.
when: After kind, before branding.

title: Automation rules
shows: Opt-in when → then rules. Opinion as choice, not law.
why: When → then rules without code. Opinions as choices, not law.
how: e.g. session with no same-day practice → warn; two missed practices → backlog.
when: After the teaching loop is live — not on day 0.

title: Integrations
shows: Connect Google, Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, email, payments. Freeze a port without deleting data.
why: Vendor ports sit at the edge. Logic stays in services. Mock until keys exist.
how: Meet/Teams, WhatsApp, email, payments.
when: After branding, before going live with real students.
